about: the switches of the addition of 2026-11-18. The keys, the direction files and the LoRA are not included: they were written by experimental scripts

end_after_sentence.direction: the row of the end-of-turn token in the output weight matrix
end_after_sentence.key: least squares with equal weight per cell: 1 at sentence ends of replies that start with the acknowledgment marker, 0 at every other position. Built with a method added after seeing results: the cells of sentence ends in replies to inputs that should be answered weigh 10 times, and the key is shrunk until its cross-validated false positives just meet the limit (2%). Layer 16 was the only layer that met the conditions
end_after_sentence.stage2: the same key rebuilt after re-reading the hidden states with the first-stage switch in place (end_after_sentence_stage2)

lower_marker.direction: minus the row of the acknowledgment marker
lower_marker.key: 1 at positions after 0 of replies that start with the marker

positions_after0_of_fish.note: measured by reading the replies of the fish condition with the edit in place; needs the model to recount
